jishuDefault.label: Default orchestration
jishuDefault.description: Architecture, development, testing, and audit roles for common HUB tasks.

architect.name: Architect
architect.responsibility1: Clarify architecture boundaries, dependencies, and implementation approach.
architect.responsibility2: Produce the design constraints that downstream roles must follow.
architect.acceptance1: Architecture decisions are explicit and actionable.
architect.acceptance2: Risks and integration points are identified.

developer.name: Developer
developer.responsibility1: Implement the required changes according to the architecture direction.
developer.responsibility2: Keep changes scoped and compatible with existing project conventions.
developer.acceptance1: Code paths needed by the task are implemented.

tester.name: Tester
tester.responsibility1: Design and run focused validation for the delivered changes.
tester.responsibility2: Report regressions, missing coverage, and reproducible failures.

auditor.name: Auditor
auditor.responsibility1: Review the final implementation for correctness, risk, and missing tests.
auditor.responsibility2: Feed actionable rework items back to the responsible role.
auditor.acceptance1: Findings are tied to concrete files or behavior.

gstack.label: GStack
gstack.description: Goal-first decomposition with solution build and feedback validation.

goalOwner.name: Goal owner
goalOwner.responsibility1: Clarify goal, scope, constraints, and success signals.
goalOwner.responsibility2: Convert the task description into measurable work slices.
goalOwner.acceptance2: Work slices map back to the original task.

solutionBuilder.name: Solution builder
solutionBuilder.responsibility1: Build the solution that satisfies the selected goal slices.
solutionBuilder.responsibility2: Record decisions and dependencies that affect later validation.
solutionBuilder.acceptance1: Implemented output covers the selected slices.

feedbackValidator.name: Feedback validator
feedbackValidator.responsibility1: Validate output against goal signals and user expectations.
feedbackValidator.responsibility2: Convert gaps into precise follow-up work.
feedbackValidator.acceptance1: Validation result is tied to goal signals.

superpowers.label: Superpowers
superpowers.description: Brainstorm, plan, implement, and verify with evidence before completion.

brainstormer.name: Brainstormer
brainstormer.responsibility1: Explore intent, constraints, and possible approaches before implementation.
brainstormer.responsibility2: Surface key decisions that need to be fixed in the plan.
brainstormer.acceptance1: User intent is reflected in the chosen approach.

planner.name: Planner
planner.responsibility1: Turn the chosen approach into ordered implementation steps.
planner.acceptance1: Plan has clear sequence and scope.

implementer.name: Implementer
implementer.responsibility1: Execute the plan in scoped changes.
implementer.responsibility2: Keep the implementation aligned with existing code style.

verifier.name: Verifier
verifier.responsibility1: Run the agreed verification and inspect failures systematically.
verifier.acceptance1: Verification commands have passing output or documented blockers.

openspec.label: OpenSpec
openspec.description: Spec-first change flow with implementation and conformance validation.

specAuthor.name: Spec author
specAuthor.responsibility1: Write the capability intent, requirements, and acceptance criteria.
specAuthor.responsibility2: Separate current behavior from requested behavior.
specAuthor.acceptance1: Spec captures the requested change clearly.

changeDesigner.name: Change designer
changeDesigner.responsibility1: Map spec requirements to affected modules and interfaces.

implementationOwner.name: Implementation owner
implementationOwner.responsibility2: Keep traceability from requirements to code changes.

specValidator.name: Spec validator
specValidator.responsibility1: Validate implementation against the written spec.
specValidator.acceptance2: Gaps are assigned to an owner.

compound.label: Compound Engineering
compound.description: Parallel engineering flow with orchestration, integration, and quality audit.

orchestrator.name: Orchestrator
orchestrator.responsibility1: Split the task into parallel-safe work packages and assign ownership.
orchestrator.responsibility2: Monitor progress and resolve dependency conflicts.
orchestrator.acceptance1: Work packages have owners and boundaries.

parallelEngineer.name: Parallel engineer
parallelEngineer.responsibility1: Deliver an assigned work package independently.

integrator.name: Integrator
integrator.responsibility1: Merge parallel outputs into one coherent result.
integrator.responsibility2: Resolve conflicts and preserve cross-role intent.

qualityAuditor.name: Quality auditor
qualityAuditor.responsibility1: Audit integrated output for correctness, consistency, and regressions.
qualityAuditor.responsibility2: Route rework to the responsible role.
